tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by three different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
The Trump administration has banned DeepSeek from federal agencies, confirmed by Gizmodo, citing data risks and alleged distillation practices.
OpenAI is inching toward a Frontier bill and backing an artificial intelligence kill switch, reported by Punchbowl News, as rivals face criticism over weak safety proposals.
An accused OpenAI engineer had a folder called Saudi Gov Docs, the FBI says, confirmed by Ars Technica, though the US denies releasing details about the alleged spy.
Microsoft has launched Guardian Agents to monitor artificial intelligence agents, confirmed by TechCrunch, warning that frontier models can't be trusted and urging enterprises to separate artificial intelligence supply from control.
The Washington Post reported on artificial intelligence and technology, including an update on Anthropic's leaked bill.
Free every hour.
